nomes: Porter Stemmer (ポルトガル語対応)
resumos: ポルトガル語の語幹抽出とアクセント正規化に特化したライブラリ（Python/JavaScriptなど）。
Stemming/tokenization libraries for Portuguese to integrate with BM25 search engines (e.g., Meilisearch/Tantivy).
Portuguese-specific stemming library to pair with Unidecode for linguistic normalization in search.
Stopword lists for Portuguese to filter noise in keyword search alongside Unidecode.
